description: Get the Pearson correlation of daily prices between two commodities over a trailing window, with strength, direction, stability and a rolling series (type=analysis, the default); only the rolling series for a chosen window (type=rolling); or a correlation matrix for 2 to 10 commodities (type=matrix with commodities). Use when the user asks how closely two prices move together. Analytics are plan-gated: the API answers HTTP 403 when the account's plan does not include them. Requires an eligible account entitlement. Use opa_get_plans for current access and pricing; the API response is authoritative.

commodities.description: For type=matrix: 2 to 10 commodity names or codes.

window.description: Rolling window in days for type=rolling (API default 7).

name: opa_get_price_correlation
title: Get Price Correlation
